defs.def: not dirty 洁净的；干净的

ex.s: Cleaning the lounge.
ex.t: 清理休息室。

ex.s: She hopes that every kid can have a clean mouth and a broad smile.
ex.t: 她希望每个孩子都能拥有干净的嘴和灿烂的笑容。

ex.s: The human body is 60% water and we need to drink lots of water to be healthy When we are thirsty we just go to the kitchen and fill a glass with clean water.
ex.t: 人体60%是水，我们需要喝大量水来保持健康。口渴时，我们只需去厨房倒一杯干净的水。

ex.s: 35 People give them money to do this and all the money helps get clean water to as many people as possible around the world.
ex.t: 35 人们给他们钱来做这件事，而所有的钱都帮助全世界尽可能多的人获得洁净的饮用水。

ex.s: Did you know that around 750 million people do not have clean water to drink?
ex.t: 你知道吗，全球约有 7.5 亿人喝不到干净的水？

ex.s: “Our hope is to have a clean, attractant-free place where bears can pass through without learning bad habits,“ says James Jonkel, longtime biologist who manages bears in and around Missoula.
ex.t: 我们的希望是拥有一个干净、无诱饵的地方，让熊可以穿行而过而不养成坏习惯，长期在米苏拉及周边管理熊的生物学家詹姆斯·琼克尔说。

ex.s: G Tell everyone to bring clean clothes in good condition
ex.t: G 告诉每个人带上状况良好的干净衣服

ex.s: Jenna told Jeff to clean it up so they could continue to cook the rest of the porridge.
ex.t: 珍娜让杰夫把它清理干净，这样他们就可以继续煮剩下的粥。

ex.s: Jenna told Jeff to clean it up so they could continue to cook the rest of the porridge.
ex.t: 珍娜让杰夫把它清理干净，这样他们就可以继续煮剩下的粥。

ex.s: Also, we use a lot of energy to process clean water.
ex.t: 此外，我们使用大量能源来处理干净的水。

defs.def: having a clean appearance and clean surroundings 爱干净的；爱整洁的

ex.s: Clean the balcony.
ex.t: 清洁阳台。

ex.s: Sometimes, a cleaner living room is the best reward.
ex.t: 有时候，更整洁的客厅就是最好的奖励。

ex.s: 34 On this day every year, countries around the world hold events to educate people about the problems of dirty water and that clean water is something that everyone should have around the world.
ex.t: 34 每年的这一天，世界各国举办活动，教育人们关于污水的问题，以及清洁的水是全世界每个人都应有的东西。

ex.s: According to the reviews, these hotels are clean, central and inexpensive.
ex.t: 根据评价，这些酒店干净整洁，位于市中心，价格便宜。

defs.def: free from harmful or unpleasant substances 无有害物的；无污染的

ex.s: “The ability to design, build and export green technologies for producing clean water, clean air and healthy and abundant food is going to be the currency of power in the new century.”
ex.t: “设计、制造并向其他国家出口用于生产清洁水、清洁空气以及健康丰足食物的绿色技术的能力，将成为新世纪里实力的象征。”

ex.s: There is also research showing that pot plants can clean the air around them by removing harmful gases, such as carbon dioxide.
ex.t: 还有研究表明，盆栽植物可以通过去除二氧化碳等有害气体来净化周围的空气。

defs.def: with nothing written on it 空白的；未写过的
not offensive or referring to sex; not doing anything that is considered immoral or bad 文明的；无色情的；正派的
not showing or having any record of doing sth that is against the law 无犯罪记录的；守法的；清白的
not owning or carrying anything illegal such as drugs or weapons 没有私藏（或携带）违禁品（如毒品、武器等）的

ex.s: Then I noticed folk conducting spring cleans dropping boxes of voluminous books on various subjects there.
ex.t: 后来我注意到人们在春季大扫除时往那里放了很多装满各种书籍的大箱子。

ex.s: She also approached dentists to learn more about teeth cleaning.
ex.t: 她还拜访牙医，以了解更多关于洁牙的知识。

ex.s: He also designed an eco-machine to clean canal water in Fuzhou, a city in southeast China.
ex.t: 他还设计了一台生态机器，用于净化中国东南部城市福州的运河水。

ex.s: It turns rotten arugula into clean fuel.
ex.t: 它把变质的芝麻菜转化成清洁燃料。

ex.s: be used to clean the oceans
ex.t: 被用于清洁海洋

ex.s: Barcelona has put together a package of clean energy technologies to help public transportation go greener, while also doing its part to tackle climate change and aid Europe’s difficult shift to the privately owned electric vehicle market.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那已经汇集了一整套清洁能源技术，以帮助公共交通走向绿色，同时也在应对气候变化并帮助欧洲艰难地转向私人拥有的电动车辆市场方面尽了自己的职责。

ex.s: When he got older, John started to wonder if this process could be used to clean up the messes people were making.
ex.t: 长大后，约翰开始想这个过程是否可以用来清理人类制造的垃圾。

ex.s: Fresh air cleans our lungs.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 新鲜空气清洁我们的肺部。

ex.s: Mabry works circles around all the students， cleaning up messes others don't want to touch． He doesn't expect a lot． Mabry said he hadn't planned to do much for his milestone birthday，so he was happy the students had prepared the surprise celebration．
ex.t: 马布里围着所有学生忙碌，清理别人不愿碰的脏乱。他要求不多。马布里说他原本没有打算为这个里程碑式的生日做什么，所以学生们准备了这场惊喜庆祝活动，他很高兴。

ex.s: We had to have a bit of a production line going, making up “tiger milk”, washing baby bottles, and cleaning the floors.
ex.t: 当斑点和条纹四个月大时，它们学会了开门和跳围栏，我们知道真的是时候送它们走了。

ex.s: I really don’t think it’s worth the effort of spending so much time preparing for a single meal, and then another hour cleaning up the mess after its’ over.
ex.t: 我真的不认为花这么多时间准备一顿饭，然后在结束后再花一个小时清理烂摊子是值得的。

defs.def: played or done in a fair way and within the rules 公平的；守规则的；不违例的
having a smooth edge, surface or shape; simple and regular 边缘平整的；表面平滑的；简洁规则的
done in a skilful and accurate way 动作熟练而准确的；干净利落的

ex.s: With the right combination of animals and plants, he figured, maybe he could clean up waste the way nature did.
ex.t: 他想，通过正确的动植物组合，也许他能像大自然那样清理废物。

defs.def: tasting, smelling or looking pleasant and fresh 清醇的；清新的
a complete separation from a person, an organization, a way of life, etc. （与人、组织、生活方式等的）彻底决裂
a break in a bone in one place 一处骨折
to remove all the people or things from an organization that are thought to be unnecessary or need changing 全部撤换；彻底清除
to win all the prizes or parts of a game or competition; to win an election completely （比赛或竞赛中）大获全胜，包揽（所有奖项）；获得选举全胜

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

defs.def: to make sth free from dirt or dust by washing or rubbing it 除去 … 的灰尘；使 … 干净；打扫

ex.s: We don’t really buy fresh food, and I suppose the fridge could be kind of cleaner...
ex.t: 我们其实不怎么买新鲜食物，而且我觉得冰箱本可以再干净点……

ex.s: Let's start doing what we can to make the world a greener, cleaner place!
ex.t: 让我们竭尽全力，让世界变得更环保、更干净！

defs.def: to become clean 变干净
这件大衣脏了，我得送去干洗。

ex.s: Instead of walking a few blocks to pick up a child or the dry cleaning, they send the self-driving minibus.
ex.t: 他们不是步行几个街区去接孩子或取干洗的衣服，而是派出自动驾驶小巴。

defs.def: to remove the inside parts of a fish, chicken, etc. before you cook it （烹调前给鱼、鸡等）清除内脏
to remove people or things that are not necessary or wanted 清除不必要的人（或事物）；裁减

ex.s: The truth is that we are lucky enough to have clean water whenever we want, but this is not the case for many people around the world.
ex.t: 事实是，我们很幸运，随时都能获得干净的水，但世界上许多人并非如此。

defs.def: to make your house clean 打扫房屋

ex.s: Praising the effort and not the outcome can also mean recognizing your child when she has worked hard to clean the yard, cook dinner, or finish a book report.
ex.t: 表扬努力而非结果，也意味着当孩子努力清扫院子、做饭或完成读书报告时认可她。
